metadata.title: AN ORDINANCE ADOPTING THE MANILA COMPREHENSIVE LAND USE PLAN AND ZONING REGULATIONS OF 2006 AND PROVIDING FOR THE ADMINISTRATION, ENFORCEMENT AND AMENDMENT THERETO.[cite: 2]
metadata.approved_by_mayor: JOSE L. ATIENZA, JR., Mayor, City of Manila[cite: 2]
metadata.acting_presiding_officer: MA. THERESA B. BONOAN-DAVID, Acting Presiding Officer, City Council, Manila[cite: 2]
principal_authors: Hon. Danilo Victor H. Lacuna, Jr.[cite: 2]
HON. ERNESTO G. DIONISIO, Majority Floor Leader[cite: 2]
HON. MA. THERESA B. BONOAN-DAVID, Acting Presiding Officer[cite: 2]

sections.title: Title of the Ordinance.[cite: 2]
sections.content: This Ordinance shall be known as the Manila Comprehensive Land Use Plan and Zoning Ordinance of 2006 and shall hereinafter be referred to as the 'Ordinance', for brevity.[cite: 2]

sections.title: Authority.[cite: 2]
sections.content: This Ordinance is enacted pursuant to the provisions of RA 7160 otherwise known as the Local Government Code of 1991, particularly sub-paragraphs vii to x, Paragraph 2 Sections 458 thereof 'Authorizing the City through the Sangguniang Panglunsod to adopt Zoning Ordinance subject to the provisions of existing laws', and in conformity with E.O. No. 72.[cite: 2]

sections.title: Purposes.[cite: 2]
sections.content: This Ordinance is enacted for the following purposes: 1. Guide, control and regulate future growth and development in accordance with its Land Use and Structure Plans.[cite: 2] 2. Protect the character and stability of residential, commercial, industrial, institutional, urban, open spaces and other functional areas within the locality and promote the orderly and beneficial development of the same.[cite: 2] 3. Promote and protect public health, safety, peace, morals, comfort, convenience and general welfare of the inhabitants of the City.[cite: 2] 4. Create new opportunities for growth and change in order to improve the quality of life and the economic well being of the City.[cite: 2] 5. Provide the proper regulatory environment to maximize opportunities for creativity, innovation and make ample room for development within the framework of the City's over-all goals and objectives.[cite: 2]

sections.title: General Zoning Principle.[cite: 2]
sections.content: This Zoning Regulation is based on the approved Manila Comprehensive Land Use Plan as adopted in this Ordinance.[cite: 2]

sections.title: Division into Zones or Districts.[cite: 2]
sections.content: The City of Manila is hereby divided into the following zones or districts:[cite: 2]
zones_listed: A. General Residential Zone: High Density Residential/Mixed Use Zone (R-3/MXD)[cite: 2]
B. Commercial Zones: Medium Intensity Commercial/Mixed Use Zone (C-2/MXD)[cite: 2]; High Intensity Commercial/Mixed Use Zone (C-3/MXD)[cite: 2]
C. Industrial Zone: Light Industrial Zone (1-1)[cite: 2]
D. Institutional Zones: General Institutional Zone (INS-G)[cite: 2]; University Cluster Zone (INS-U)[cite: 2]

E. Public Open Space Zones: General Public Open Space Zone (POS-GEN)[cite: 2]; Parks and Plazas (POS-PP)[cite: 2]; Playground and Sports Field/Recreation Zone (POS-PSR)[cite: 2]; Cemetery Zone (POS-CEM)[cite: 2]
F. Others: Utility Zone (UTL)[cite: 2]; Water Zone (WTR)[cite: 2]
G. Overlay Zones: Histo-Cultural Heritage Overlay Zone (O-HCH)[cite: 2]; Planned Unit Development Overlay Zone (O-PUD)[cite: 2]; Buffer Overlay Zone (O-BUF)[cite: 2]

sections.title: General Provision.[cite: 2]
sections.content: The uses enumerated in the succeeding sections are neither exhaustive nor all-inclusive.[cite: 2] Developments of Mixed-Use character (R3/MXD, C2/MXD) shall have a 70/30 sharing of uses. Where 70% of the development must be of the principal use (e.g. R3/MXD the principal use is residential) and the other 30% can be of any of the allowed uses within the zone category.[cite: 2]

sections.title: Use Regulations in High Density Residential/Mixed Use Zone (R-3/MXD).[cite: 2]
Use Regulations in Medium Intensity Commercial/Mixed Use Zone (C-2/MXD).[cite: 2]
Use Regulations in High Intensity Commercial/Mixed Use Zone (C-3/MXD).[cite: 2]
Use Regulations in General Institutional Zone (INS-G).[cite: 2]
Use Regulations in University Cluster Zone (INS-U).[cite: 2]
Zoning Permit (Locational Clearance).[cite: 2]
sections.content: All lot/land owners/land developers and business establishments shall secure a zoning permit (locational clearance) from the City Planning and Development Officer for all conforming uses.[cite: 2]

sections.title: Period of Zoning Permit's Approval/Disapproval.[cite: 2]
sections.content: The approval/disapproval of zoning permit shall not be withheld for more than thirty (30) days from receipt of application.[cite: 2]

sections.title: Collection of Fees for Zoning Permit (Locational Clearance).[cite: 2]

application_fees.complaints: PhP 1,000.00 (except those involving pauper Litigants which shall be free of charge)[cite: 2]

zoning_fees: A. RESIDENTIAL: High Density Residential/Mixed Use (R-3/MXD) - PhP 3.00/sq.m. of TFA[cite: 2]

B. COMMERCIAL: Medium Density Commercial/Mixed Use (C-2/MXD) - PhP 5.00/sq.m. of TFA[cite: 2]; High Density Commercial/Mixed Use (C-3/MXD) - PhP 5.00/sq.m. of TFA[cite: 2]; Yards utilized for commercial purposes - PhP 3.00/sq.m. of TLA[cite: 2]
C. INDUSTRIAL: Light Industrial (1-1) - PhP 8.00/sq.m. of TFA[cite: 2]; Yards utilized for industrial purposes - PhP 5.00/sq.m. of TLA[cite: 2]
D. UTILITY (UTL): Building Structure - PhP 8.00/sq.m. of TFA[cite: 2]; Yards utilized for utility purposes - PhP 5.00/sq.m. of TLA[cite: 2]

E. INSTITUTIONAL: General Institutional (INS-G) - PhP 4.00/sq.m. of TFA[cite: 2]; University Cluster (INS-U) - PhP 4.00/sq.m. of TFA[cite: 2]; Yards utilized for institutional purposes - PhP 1.00/sq.m. of TLA[cite: 2]

sections.title: Building Permit./Business Permit.[cite: 2]
sections.content: No building and business permit shall be issued by the Local Building Officer and Business Promotion and Development Officer respectively without a valid zoning permit (locational clearance) in accordance with this Ordinance.[cite: 2]

sections.title: Penal Provisions.[cite: 2]
sections.content: Any person violating any provision of this Ordinance, shall, upon conviction, be punished by a fine of not more than Five Thousand Pesos (PhP5,000.00) or by imprisonment for not more than one (1) year or both such fine and imprisonment, at the discretion of the Court.[cite: 2]

sections.title: Effectivity Clause.[cite: 2]
sections.content: This Ordinance shall take effect upon its approval.[cite: 2]
